name: Around the trees
blurb: Trees have no dot. Another stick and a ball sit on walks that still reach the flag.
aside: The other lane runs A8, A7, A6, A5, B5, C5. It is the same number of steps and it skips the treat, so it scores −8. The stick at A4 is a longer left-hand walk, A5, A4, B4, C4, and it reaches the flag at −8. The ball at D4 is two steps past the first stick, and that walk scores −8 as well. The best line scores −7.
